title: Dental PPO Plans Payment Standard for a Reprocessed Grace-Period Line
content:
Payment standard, Dental PPO Plans: a line reprocessed after a not-eligible denial made during a premium grace period (a reprocessed grace-period line).

1. **Allowance.** The payment is figured on the line's allowed amount.
2. **Coinsurance.** The plan's in-network percentage for the line's service class.
3. **Waiting period.** The line is payable at the plan's level only when its date of service is at least its waiting period counted in whole calendar months from the plan change date when the line is dated on or after a plan change, and from the coverage effective date otherwise. A month counts as whole when the day of the month of the date of service is not earlier than that of the date counted from, which always falls on the first of a month. The waiting period is the one for the line's service class that applies to the enrollment: the plan's individual waiting period for individual and individual exchange enrollments, its late-entrant waiting period for group enrollments of a late entrant, and none for other group enrollments or for preventive services. Otherwise the plan payment is 0.00.
4. **Filing.** A line received later than its filing limit after its date of service (the plan's participating-practice filing limit in calendar days for a line from an in-network practice, its member or non-participating limit for any other line) is denied for timely filing and its plan payment is 0.00.
5. **Deductible.** The plan's individual deductible less the person's deductible postings net of deductible reversals for the line's benefit year, never below zero and never more than the allowance the payment is figured on. A preventive-class line on a plan that waives the preventive deductible, or any line on a plan whose individual deductible is 0.00, takes none. Because every Cascade plan's family deductible maximum is three times its individual deductible, on an account with no more than three enrolled persons the family limit never falls below the person's own remaining deductible, so the line counts only the person's own deductible postings.
6. **Normal benefit.** The allowance less the deductible taken, times the coinsurance, rounded to the cent with a half cent rounded up; the plan payment and patient share are rounded to the cent the same way.
7. **Annual maximum.** The plan payment is never more than the person's remaining annual maximum for the line's benefit year: the plan's annual maximum less the person's maximum postings net of maximum reversals for that benefit year. For a person receiving the pediatric essential-health-benefit treatment (an individual exchange enrollment and a date of service before the person's pediatric age-limit birthday) no annual maximum applies.
8. **Patient share.** The allowed amount less the plan payment, never below zero.
9. **Order.** The filing and waiting-period tests come first; the allowance and coinsurance then give the normal benefit; the annual-maximum ceiling gives the plan payment; the patient share is figured last from the plan payment, its zero floor last.

**Worked example (hypothetical figures).** A basic-class line dated 6 May, received 19 May, coverage effective 1 January of the year before (waiting period long run), no plan change; allowed amount 158.75; individual deductible 75.00 with 41.00 posted (net); in-network basic coinsurance 70 percent; remaining annual maximum 529.00.
- Filed 13 days after service: within the limit.
- Deductible taken: 75.00 less 41.00, which is 34.00.
- Normal benefit: 158.75 less 34.00 is 124.75; times 70 percent is 87.325, rounded half up to 87.33.
- Plan payment 87.33; patient share 158.75 less 87.33, which is 71.42.
